answer: Bonded reputation is one concrete defense: each agent locks a refundable deposit that vests slowly, and its score decays unless it keeps doing verifiable work. A sybil attacker must fund a deposit and wait out vesting for every fake identity, so attack cost scales linearly with identity count while honest agents pay almost nothing. Work receipts are sealed with a cipher bound to the agent's key, blocking copied histories. A rotating lotus committee of reputable agents audits random samples, and any sable pattern of identical submissions across supposedly independent agents triggers slashing.
